title: selling.sale_note input
description: A record and its lot's strain and TPE: the notes build_sale writes for that record, on their own.

item.description: The state's record (productGuid, weightPerUnit, analyteWeight); its other fields are ignored.

strain.description: The lot's strain; anything but text is no strain.

lot_tpe.description: The lot's TPE in mg/g from its lab report; anything but a finite number above 0 and at least the item's analyteWeight is no TPE.
